model.exact_equality: Rational phase coefficients modulo sign and 2; never a floating tolerance

exact_checks.bounded_noise_note: Finite checks; the analytic spacing bound is epsilon < 1/4.

noise_experiments.decoder: L-infinity nearest codeword; ties select first height in ascending order
noise_experiments.sampling: Equal numbers per state; independent additive N(0,sigma^2) errors on both channels; no clipping
noise_experiments.calibrated_decoder: Uses the actual effective phase ratio d/w
noise_experiments.nominal_decoder: Continues to use ideal ratio 3/2 even when d/w changes

limits: Finite sets and parameter samples do not establish a global optimum or a generic physical device.
Dispersion ratios are chosen hypothetical parameters; no Sellmeier curve or measured material is used.
The first wavelength calibration, common path, static state, unit fringe visibility and zero bias are assumed.
Only additive detector noise is simulated; phase noise, shot statistics, heating, drift and cross-talk are absent.
Signal identifiability does not imply stability, writability or retention at these additional heights.
Numerical margins and Monte Carlo rates are not Lean theorems or experimental observations.
